description: This file defines the kaitenrestInterface class, which provides an implementation for an issue tracker interface for Kaiten via REST API in a TestLink plugin. It includes methods for connecting, retrieving issues, adding issues, and managing issue notes, as well as configuration templates.

classes.name: kaitenrestInterface
classes.description: A class implementing the interface to Kaiten issue tracking system using REST API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the kaitenrestInterface instance, sets configuration, and establishes connection.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration with default values and options.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client instance used for Kaiten API interactions.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the provided issue ID string has valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Kaiten system and initializes API client.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Kaiten is active.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Builds the URL for viewing a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves issue details from Kaiten by issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Provides a verbose status string for an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Gets the HTML string summarizing the issue.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether an issue with the given ID exists.

methods.name: parseAddInfo
methods.description: Parses additional info string to extract links and description.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Kaiten with a summary, additional info, and options.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to an existing issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration snippet for setting up Kaiten integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created through API.
